## \_KbCallbackData type

Callback data produced by `Page.data.callbackQueryData(...)`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type _KbCallbackData<P extends typeof Ctx = typeof Ctx, A extends Array<string | undefined> = []> = {
    result: string;
    page: P;
    args: A;
};
```
**References:** [Ctx](./gramstax.ctx.md)

## Remarks

Object format `{result, page, args}`<!-- -->: `result` is the string sent to Telegram, `page` is the destination page class, `args` is the arg tuple passed at call time.
